content.title: Artivion’s (NYSE:AORT) Q3 Sales Top Estimates
content.summary: Medical device company Artivion (NYSE:AORT) beat Wall Street’s revenue expectations in Q3 CY2025, with sales up 18.4% year on year to $113.4 million. The company’s full-year revenue guidance of $442 million at the midpoint came in 0.9% above analysts’ estimates. Its non-GAAP profit of $0.16 per share was in line with analysts’ consensus estimates.
